title: How is HR Tek Systems priced overall?
text: HR Tek Systems pricing includes annual platform subscription plans by organization size and standalone report pricing (per module).
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure) p1-p2

title: What HR Advisory Engines are offered?
text: Engines include: HR Tech Maturity Assessment, Digital Roadmap Generator, HCM Vendor Fit Engine, Shared Services Operating Model Planner, and Emotionally Intelligent Change Management.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: Can clients subscribe to modules individually or buy a bundle?
text: Clients can subscribe to modules individually or access all modules under bundled plans.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What does the annual subscription include?
text: Annual platform subscription plans include dashboard, platform access, report engine, user support, and select free modules.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What is the Starter tier pricing and what’s included?
text: Starter tier is for employee size <250 with annual subscription fee ₹0 (Freemium). Free engines included: Dashboard only.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What is the Growth tier pricing and what’s included?
text: Growth tier is for employee size 250-750 with annual subscription fee ₹3,00,000. Free engines included: 1 Engine.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What is the Standard tier pricing and what’s included?
text: Standard tier is for employee size 751-1500 with annual subscription fee ₹5,00,000. Free engines included: 2 Engine.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What is the Professional tier pricing and what’s included?
text: Professional tier is for employee size 1501-5000 with annual subscription fee ₹7,50,000. Free engines included: 3 Engine.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What is the Enterprise tier pricing and what’s included?
text: Enterprise tier is for employee size 5001-20,000 with annual subscription fee ₹10,00,000. Free engines included: All Engine.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What is the Global tier pricing and what’s included?
text: Global tier is for employee size 20,000+ with custom pricing (starts ₹12,00,000). Includes all engines plus advisory.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: What extra benefits do annual plans include?
text: Annual plans include centralized dashboard hosting, benchmarking engine, and export access.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p1

title: Can free/basic plan clients purchase reports individually?
text: Clients on free or basic plans can purchase any report individually using standalone report pricing (per module).
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Standalone pricing: HR Tech Maturity Assessment report
text: HR Tech Maturity Assessment report price per report is ₹40,000.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Standalone pricing: Digital HR Roadmap Generator report
text: Digital HR Roadmap Generator report price per report is ₹45,000.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Standalone pricing: HCM Vendor Fit Engine report
text: HCM Vendor Fit Engine report price per report is ₹35,000.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Standalone pricing: SSC/COE Shared Service Planner report
text: SSC/COE Shared Service Planner report price per report is ₹45,000.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Standalone pricing: EI Change Management Analysis report
text: EI Change Management Analysis report price per report is ₹45,000.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Standalone pricing: All 5 modules combo
text: All 5 Modules Combo is priced at ₹1,85,000 (Save ₹25,000).
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Are prices inclusive of GST?
text: All prices are exclusive of GST (18%).
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: How are subscription plans billed?
text: Subscription plans are annually billed.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: How can users pay for individual reports and add-ons?
text: Individual reports and add-ons are pay-per-use via Razor-pay, UPI, Net Banking, or Invoice.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: When is payment due after invoice?
text: Payment is due within 7 days of invoice.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: What is the refund policy in the consolidated pricing structure?
text: Refunds are offered only in cases of technical failure or billing error.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2

title: Suggested pricing page call-to-action (CTA)
text: Suggested CTA: "Ready to unlock your HR transformation journey? Start with your dashboard for free, and upgrade anytime to access full strategic insights."
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf p2
